1. Free features and Metre Pro

Length, height, the bubble level, the on-screen ruler, all how-to demos and saving measurements are free with no time limit. Metre Pro unlocks every other tool and all exports (PDF, CSV, DXF, USDZ).

2. Subscriptions, trials and purchases

  • Metre Pro is offered as an auto-renewable weekly or monthly subscription, or as a one-time lifetime purchase. The price and period are shown in the app, in your local currency, before you confirm.
  • The weekly and monthly plans include a 3-day free trial for eligible new subscribers. If you do not cancel at least 24 hours before the trial ends, the subscription starts and the price is charged.
  • Payment is charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase or, for a plan with a free trial, when the trial ends.
  • A subscription renews automatically for the same period unless it is cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account is charged for renewal within the 24 hours before the current period ends.
  • You can manage or cancel subscriptions in iOS Settings → [your name] → Subscriptions, or from Settings → Manage subscription in Metre. Deleting the app does not cancel a subscription.
  • Any unused portion of a free trial is forfeited when you purchase a subscription.
  • The lifetime purchase is a single payment with no renewal. If you buy it while a subscription or trial is active, cancel the subscription in your Apple ID settings so that it does not renew.
  • Purchases are linked to your Apple ID. Use Settings → Restore purchases in Metre to unlock Pro on another device signed in with the same Apple ID.
  • Billing and refunds are handled by Apple under its policies. You can request a refund at reportaproblem.apple.com; we cannot issue refunds ourselves.

3. Measurements are estimates

Metre measures with the camera, motion sensors and, where available, LiDAR. Results depend on your device, light, surfaces, distance and how the phone is held, so every measurement, area, volume, floor plan, size and calculated quantity is an estimate.

  • Verify critical dimensions with a physical tape before you cut, drill, order materials, buy furniture or build.
  • Metre is not a certified or calibrated measuring instrument. Do not use it where legally certified measurement is required (for example trade, land survey or official floor area), or for medical, safety-critical or structural decisions.
  • Body measurements, ring and shoe sizes and child heights are guidance for everyday use, not medical or professional fitting advice.
  • Material quantities (paint, flooring, tiles, concrete and others) are estimates; follow the manufacturer’s coverage figures and allow for waste.

4. Use it safely

Stay aware of your surroundings while you look at the screen. Do not use Metre while driving, on ladders or roofs, near drops, stairs or traffic, or anywhere looking at a phone could put you or others at risk. Supervise children who use the app.

5. Your content

Your measurements, notes, plans and exports belong to you. They are stored on your device and we have no access to them, so please keep your own backups of anything important. See the Privacy Policy.

6. Liability

To the extent permitted by law, Metre is provided “as is”, and we are not liable for losses that result from relying on a measurement without checking it, or for indirect or consequential losses. Nothing in these terms limits liability that cannot be limited by law, or your statutory rights as a consumer.

7. Changes

We may update these terms, for example when features or plans change. The current version is always published at this address with its effective date. Changes to the price of an existing subscription are handled by Apple, which informs you in advance and asks for your consent where required.
